resolucao_cfp_9_2024_atendimento_fb2ac: CFP Resolution 9/2024: online psychological care | Espaço Prelúdio
resumo_pratico_da_resolucao_cfp_89138: A practical summary of CFP Resolution No. 9/2024 on psychology mediated by digital technologies: end of e-Psi registration, case-by-case assessment, record keeping, and confidentiality safeguards.
resolucao_cfp_n_9_2024_8f519: CFP Resolution No. 9/2024: what changes in online psychological care
a_resolucao_cfp_n_9_43290: CFP Resolution No. 9 of July 18, 2024 began regulating the provision of psychological services mediated by digital information and communication technologies. This summary highlights what changed in practice.
a_norma_revogou_a_resolucao_84c5c: The rule revoked CFP Resolution No. 11/2018, which had regulated online care until then, and CFP Resolution No. 4/2020, issued during the pandemic. Today, the rules for remote care are consolidated in the 2024 text.
pela_regra_anterior_o_psicologo_07016: Under the previous rule, psychologists had to register in advance on the e-Psi platform to provide online care. With the 2024 resolution, this registration no longer exists. To provide care through digital means, an active registration with the Regional Council of Psychology is enough.
a_resolucao_reforca_que_cabe_81bfa: The resolution reinforces that it is up to the psychologist to assess whether remote care is appropriate for each person and situation. This assessment must be well-founded and documented. When the digital format is not recommended, the professional must propose alternatives, such as in-person care or referral.
a_regra_de_2018_restringia_f24af: The 2018 rule restricted remote care in cases of urgency, emergency, and rights violations. The current text gives more room to the professional's technical judgment in these situations. This judgment must consider the local support network and the emergency services available to the person being treated.
a_responsabilidade_pelo_sigilo_continua_: Responsibility for confidentiality remains with the psychologist, including in the choice of tools. Prefer platforms with end-to-end encrypted video, protected notes, and access control. The platform evaluation guide includes a checklist.
confirme_que_sua_inscricao_no_5b5a1: Confirm that your CRP registration is active.
registre_no_prontuario_por_que_98e4c: Record in the chart why the remote format is appropriate for each patient.
tenha_um_plano_para_urgencias_9a3cc: Have a plan for emergencies, with contacts from the person's local support network.
use_ferramentas_que_preservem_o_bca21: Use tools that preserve the confidentiality of audio, video, and notes.
leia_o_texto_integral_da_9a25b: Read the full text of the resolution on the Federal Council of Psychology website.
este_guia_e_informativo_ele_98405: This guide is informational. It does not replace the official text of the regulations or the guidance of your professional council.
